from pathlib import Path

import pytest

NOTES_DIR = "notes"


def first_readable(names: list[str]) -> str:
    """Return the text of the first name in `names` readable from `notes`.

    Names are untrusted and are resolved relative to the directory `notes`
    in the current working directory. A name is skipped (treated as
    unreadable) if the file is missing, is not a regular readable file
    (e.g. a directory), cannot be decoded as UTF-8 text, contains a NUL
    byte, or would resolve outside `notes` by any means (absolute paths,
    `..` components, sibling directories sharing the `notes` prefix, or
    symlinks pointing outside). Files in subdirectories of `notes` are
    allowed. Returns "" when no name is readable.
    """
    try:
        base = Path(NOTES_DIR).resolve()
    except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
        return ""
    for name in names:
        if "\x00" in name:
            continue
        try:
            candidate = (base / name).resolve()
            if candidate == base or not candidate.is_relative_to(base):
                continue
            if not candidate.is_file():
                continue
            text = candidate.read_bytes().decode("utf-8")
        except (OSError, ValueError, RuntimeError):
            continue
        if "\x00" in text:
            continue
        return text
    return ""


def _setup(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> Path:
    cwd = tmp_path / "cwd"
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR).mkdir(parents=True)
    monkeypatch.chdir(cwd)
    return cwd


def test_returns_first_readable(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "b.txt").write_text("B")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt", "b.txt"]) == "A"
    assert first_readable(["b.txt", "a.txt"]) == "B"


def test_skips_missing(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "b.txt").write_text("B")
    assert first_readable(["missing.txt", "b.txt"]) == "B"


def test_empty_and_none_readable(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    assert first_readable([]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["nope.txt", "also-nope.txt"]) == ""


def test_empty_file_is_readable(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "empty.txt").write_text("")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "b.txt").write_text("B")
    assert first_readable(["empty.txt", "b.txt"]) == ""


def test_nested_file_allowed(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "sub").mkdir()
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "sub" / "n.txt").write_text("N")
    assert first_readable(["sub/n.txt"]) == "N"


def test_directory_names_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "sub").mkdir()
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable(["sub", "", ".", "a.txt"]) == "A"
    assert first_readable(["sub", "", "."]) == ""


def test_parent_traversal_rejected(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET")
    (tmp_path / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["sub/../../secret.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["../secret.txt", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_absolute_path_rejected(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = cwd / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable([str(secret)]) == ""
    assert first_readable([str(secret.resolve()), "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_inside_absolute_path_not_a_bypass(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / "secret.txt").write_text("SECRET")
    assert first_readable(["/etc/passwd"]) == ""


def test_sibling_with_shared_prefix_rejected(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    evil = cwd / "notes_evil"
    evil.mkdir()
    (evil / "x.txt").write_text("EVIL")
    assert first_readable(["../notes_evil/x.txt"]) == ""


def test_symlink_escape_rejected(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    secret = cwd / "secret.txt"
    secret.write_text("SECRET")
    outside_dir = tmp_path / "outside"
    outside_dir.mkdir()
    (outside_dir / "o.txt").write_text("OUT")
    try:
        (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "link.txt").symlink_to(secret)
        (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "linkdir").symlink_to(outside_dir, target_is_directory=True)
    except OSError:
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable(["link.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["linkdir/o.txt"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["link.txt", "linkdir/o.txt", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_symlink_inside_notes_allowed(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "real.txt").write_text("R")
    try:
        (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "alias.txt").symlink_to(cwd / NOTES_DIR / "real.txt")
    except OSError:
        pytest.skip("symlinks not supported")
    assert first_readable(["alias.txt"]) == "R"


def test_nul_byte_name_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable(["a.txt\x00.png"]) == ""
    assert first_readable(["bad\x00name", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_undecodable_file_skipped(
    tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch
) -> None:
    cwd = _setup(tmp_path, monkeypatch)
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "bin.dat").write_bytes(b"\xff\xfe\xfa")
    (cwd / NOTES_DIR / "a.txt").write_text("A")
    assert first_readable(["bin.dat", "a.txt"]) == "A"


def test_missing_notes_dir(tmp_path: Path, monkeypatch: pytest.MonkeyPatch) -> None:
    monkeypatch.chdir(tmp_path)
    assert first_readable(["a.txt"]) == ""
